bio: Principal Research Scientist Environmental Health, Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health Departments Department of Environmental Health Physician-scientist in environmental health currently directing an independent research laboratory at Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health while maintaining active collaborations across multiple institutions. Research expertise encompasses the environmental exposome and human health impacts, wildfire smoke and air pollution immunology, microplastic detection and health effects, epigenetics and immune cell profiling, food allergy, cancer prevention, organoids, occupational health, women's health, discovery of new allergy targets for novel therapies and climate change-related allergic disease. \
